metadata.title: Accounting for Debentures
metadata.subject: Accountancy
learning_outcomes: Understand the meaning of Debentures and difference from Shares.
Pass journal entries for issue of debentures with terms of redemption.

blocks.content:
Sometimes a company needs money, but it doesn't want to make the public 'owners' by issuing shares. Instead, it asks the public for a **LOAN**.
In return for the loan, the company issues a certificate acknowledging the debt, with a promise to pay a fixed rate of interest (e.g., 9% p.a.) and repay the principal amount after a certain period (e.g., 5 years). This certificate is called a **Debenture**.
blocks.content_hi: कभी-कभी किसी कंपनी को पैसे की आवश्यकता होती है, लेकिन वह शेयर जारी करके जनता को 'मालिक' नहीं बनाना चाहती। इसके बजाय, यह जनता से **ऋण (LOAN)** मांगती है। इस प्रमाण पत्र को **ऋणपत्र (Debenture)** कहा जाता है।
blocks.content_gu: કેટલીકવાર કંપનીને પૈસાની જરૂર હોય છે, પરંતુ તે શેર બહાર પાડીને જનતાને 'માલિક' બનાવવા માંગતી નથી. તેના બદલે, તે જનતા પાસે **લોન (LOAN)** માંગે છે. આ પ્રમાણપત્રને **ડિબેન્ચર (Debenture)** કહેવામાં આવે છે.
blocks.body:
Sometimes a company needs money, but it doesn't want to make the public 'owners' by issuing shares. Instead, it asks the public for a **LOAN**.
In return for the loan, the company issues a certificate acknowledging the debt, with a promise to pay a fixed rate of interest (e.g., 9% p.a.) and repay the principal amount after a certain period (e.g., 5 years). This certificate is called a **Debenture**.
